decisions.reason: The account setup instructions govern the destination account's profile and audience-routing configuration, not which long-form videos or moments may be used as clip sources.
Creating and branding the posting account does not change the existing requirement to track every posted clip's views, performance, and engagement.
The suggested profile bio's reference to Arden Vale's best moments is descriptive account copy and does not modify the substantive standard for selecting clip moments.
Requiring account creation before clipping does not change the deferred trial batch's clip count, batch work, scope, or lifecycle.
The account setup prerequisite does not alter the monthly approved-clip target, approval rules, daily output expectation, or deferred lifecycle.
The Instagram profile and audience-routing instructions do not change the requirement that each clip form a complete, independently understandable narrative.
The account provisioning and profile instructions contain no change to the required 70-85 second clip duration.
The source decision concerns account setup and does not modify the criterion for selecting moments with good hooks.
The visual branding of the Instagram profile is distinct from the required clean, simple, professional editing style of the clips.
The profile image, bio, and account link instructions do not change the white-text-only and no-text-effects caption standard.
The account setup decision contains no instruction affecting the brand-compliant caption font.
